en.title: Team & Mixed Team Standings Determination
en.excerpt: Learn how Archeris automatically aggregates individual qualification scores to generate official Team (3 archers) and Mixed Team (1 male + 1 female) ranking leaderboards.

toc.text: 3. Mixed Team Standings (Top Male + Top Female)

en.content:
In World Archery tournament standards, team event categories do not shoot separate qualification rounds. Instead, official Team (Beregu) and Mixed Team (Beregu Campuran) rankings are calculated automatically by aggregating the scores shot by individual club archers during their respective individual qualification sessions.

1. How Team Qualification Scoring Works

Archeris automates the entire team calculation process:

  • Archers shoot their individual qualification round as usual (e.g. 72 arrows).
  • The system groups archers belonging to the same club or delegation within the same bow division and age group.
  • Team composite scores are calculated in real-time as individual arrow scores are recorded on the field.

This means no separate team shooting round is needed. The scorekeepers simply record individual arrow values, and the team standings build themselves automatically in the background.

2. Standard Team Standings (Top 3 Club Archers)

For standard gender-based team events (e.g., Recurve Men Team, Compound Women Team):

  • Roster Requirement: Minimum of 3 archers from the same club registered in that category.
  • Score Calculation: The system sums the qualification scores of the top 3 highest-scoring archers from that club:
Team Total Score = Archer 1 Score + Archer 2 Score + Archer 3 Score
Team 10s Total = Archer 1 (10s) + Archer 2 (10s) + Archer 3 (10s)
Team Xs Total  = Archer 1 (Xs)  + Archer 2 (Xs)  + Archer 3 (Xs)

If a club registers more than 3 archers in the same category, only the top 3 individual scores are selected. The other archers receive their individual ranking as normal.

3. Mixed Team Standings (Top Male + Top Female)

For Mixed Team events (e.g., Recurve Mixed Team, Barebow Mixed Team):

  • Roster Requirement: At least 1 male archer and 1 female archer from the same club competing in the same bow division and age bracket.
  • Score Calculation: The system combines the score of the highest-ranking male archer and the highest-ranking female archer from that club:
Mixed Team Total = Top Male Score + Top Female Score
Mixed Team 10s   = Top Male 10s   + Top Female 10s
Mixed Team Xs    = Top Male Xs    + Top Female Xs

The mixed team pairing is automatic. Organizers do not need to pre-declare pairings before the qualification round.

4. Running Team Synchronization in Dashboard

To compile and sync team rosters in the organizer workspace:

  1. Navigate to Organizer Dashboard > Elimination > Team Sync.
  2. Select the target category (e.g. Recurve Men Team or Compound Mixed Team).
  3. Click Synchronize Teams (Sinkronisasi Tim).
  4. The system scans all registered club athletes, calculates composite team scores, and builds official team entries automatically.

Run synchronization after qualification is fully finalized for complete standings.

5. Ranking Order & Tie-Break Hierarchy

Team rankings on the official leaderboard are determined by:

  1. Highest Cumulative Team Score (Max 2,160 pts for 3-archer team; Max 1,440 pts for Mixed team).
  2. Highest Combined 10s Count.
  3. Highest Combined Xs Count.

6. Advancing Teams to Elimination Brackets

Once team qualification standings are synchronized and finalized:

  • Top ranked teams are automatically seeded into the Team Elimination Brackets (e.g., Seed 1 vs Seed 8, Seed 2 vs Seed 7).
  • If byes are needed (e.g., 6 teams in an 8-team bracket), the top 2 ranked teams automatically receive first-round byes into the semifinals.

Once brackets are generated, scorekeepers record match arrows on the field and the system advances winners round by round.

id.title: Penentuan Peringkat Beregu & Tim Campuran
id.excerpt: Pelajari bagaimana sistem Archeris menggabungkan skor kualifikasi individu secara otomatis untuk menghasilkan peringkat Beregu (3 atlet) dan Beregu Campuran / Mixed Team (1 putra + 1 putri).

toc.text: 2. Perhitungan Beregu Standar (3 Atlet Terbaik per Klub)
3. Perhitungan Beregu Campuran (1 Putra + 1 Putri Terbaik)
4. Proses Sinkronisasi Tim di Dashboard Panitia
6. Melangkah ke Bagan Aduan Eliminasi Beregu

id.content:
Dalam standar turnamen World Archery dan Perpani, nomor beregu tidak menembak sesi kualifikasi terpisah. Peringkat resmi Beregu (Team) dan Beregu Campuran (Mixed Team) dihitung otomatis dari penggabungan skor yang diperoleh masing-masing pemanah saat menembak di babak kualifikasi perorangan.

1. Konsep Perhitungan Skor Kualifikasi Beregu

Archeris mengotomatiskan seluruh alur perhitungan tim:

  • Pemanah menembakkan sesi kualifikasi individu seperti biasa (misalnya 72 anak panah).
  • Sistem mengelompokkan atlet yang berasal dari klub yang sama di divisi dan kelompok usia yang sama.
  • Skor gabungan tim terhitung secara real-time seiring nilai panah masuk dari lapangan.

Dengan demikian, panitia tidak perlu menjadwalkan sesi kualifikasi tambahan untuk nomor beregu.

2. Perhitungan Beregu Standar (3 Atlet Terbaik per Klub)

Untuk kategori beregu gender standar (misalnya Recurve Beregu Putra atau Compound Beregu Putri):

  • Syarat Kuota: Minimal 3 pemanah dari klub yang sama terdaftar di kategori tersebut.
  • Rumus Skor: Sistem menjumlahkan total skor dari 3 pemanah dengan nilai kualifikasi tertinggi di klub tersebut:
Total Skor Beregu = Skor Atlet 1 + Skor Atlet 2 + Skor Atlet 3
Total 10s Beregu  = Total 10 (Atlet 1) + Total 10 (Atlet 2) + Total 10 (Atlet 3)
Total Xs Beregu   = Total X (Atlet 1)  + Total X (Atlet 2)  + Total X (Atlet 3)

Jika klub mendaftarkan lebih dari 3 pemanah di kategori yang sama, hanya 3 nilai tertinggi yang masuk ke perhitungan tim, sedangkan pemanah lainnya tetap mendapatkan ranking perorangan mereka.

3. Perhitungan Beregu Campuran (1 Putra + 1 Putri Terbaik)

Untuk kategori Mixed Team (misalnya Recurve Mixed Team atau Barebow Mixed Team):

  • Syarat Kuota: Minimal 1 atlet putra dan 1 atlet putri dari klub yang sama di divisi dan kelompok usia yang sama.
  • Rumus Skor: Sistem menggabungkan skor dari 1 atlet putra terbaik dan 1 atlet putri terbaik dari klub tersebut:
Total Skor Mixed Team = Skor Putra Terbaik + Skor Putri Terbaik
Total 10s Mixed Team  = Total 10 (Putra)   + Total 10 (Putri)
Total Xs Mixed Team   = Total X (Putra)    + Total X (Putri)

Pasangan tim campuran terbentuk otomatis dari peringkat tertinggi tanpa perlu didaftarkan manual sebelum sesi kualifikasi.

4. Proses Sinkronisasi Tim di Dashboard Panitia

Untuk menyusun dan menyinkronkan daftar tim di dashboard panitia:

  1. Buka Dashboard Organizer > Eliminasi > Sinkronisasi Tim.
  2. Pilih kategori lomba yang dituju (contoh: Recurve Putra Beregu atau Compound Mixed Team).
  3. Klik tombol Sinkronisasi Tim.
  4. Sistem memindai seluruh atlet klub, menghitung skor gabungan, dan membentuk entri tim resmi secara otomatis.

Lakukan sinkronisasi setelah seluruh rambahan kualifikasi selesai agar data peringkat tim lengkap dan akurat.

5. Urutan Penentu Peringkat & Aturan Tie-Break

Peringkat tim pada papan klasemen resmi ditentukan berdasarkan urutan prioritas:

  1. Total Akumulasi Skor Tim Tertinggi (Maksimal 2.160 poin untuk regu 3 orang; Maksimal 1.440 poin untuk Mixed Team).
  2. Jumlah Total Nilai 10 Terbanyak.
  3. Jumlah Total Nilai Inner-10 (X) Terbanyak.

6. Melangkah ke Bagan Aduan Eliminasi Beregu

Setelah peringkat kualifikasi tim terbentuk:

  • Tim-tim peringkat atas otomatis ditempatkan ke dalam Bagan Eliminasi Beregu (contoh: Peringkat 1 vs Peringkat 8, Peringkat 2 vs Peringkat 7).
  • Jika terdapat *bye* (misalnya hanya ada 6 tim dalam bagan 8 besar), 2 tim teratas otomatis lolos langsung ke babak semifinal.

Setelah bagan terbentuk, petugas lapangan mencatat skor pertandingan regu seperti biasa hingga babak perebutan medali emas selesai.
